expected_invariant: A frozen text-source binding must identify the same committed content in the primary and every clean exact-HEAD worker/reviewer worktree.
observed_error: The plan bound one generated JSON evidence file's primary-worktree CRLF byte hash. The clean worker checkout correctly materialized the .gitattributes-required LF bytes, so exact content produced a different raw SHA-256 and the worker candidate failed closed.
detection_method: DeepSeek returned revision_required and Sol reproduced 4143 CRLF bytes at SHA-256 34e9c7f9... in the primary versus 4070 LF bytes at SHA-256 4dd6cd63... in the exact-HEAD worker, with normalized Git diff equality.

correction.action: Freeze canonical LF UTF-8 hashing for all bound text inputs, bind the committed LF digest 4dd6cd63..., reject bare carriage returns, and require the corrected worker harness/tests to prove primary/worker invariance before occupied execution.
correction.prevention_control: Text source bindings must declare and test a checkout-stable canonical line-ending mode; raw worktree-byte hashes remain available only for explicitly binary artifacts.
